quote: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, the driver of the vehicle on the left shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: Two vehicles enter the intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, with the subject vehicle on the left.

exceptions.effect: Dependent source rule must be reviewed
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4]

exceptions.effect: This section does not apply under the quoted condition
exceptions.source_clause: this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices
exceptions.trigger: official traffic-control devices control the intersection

exceptions.effect: This section does not apply under the quoted condition
exceptions.source_clause: to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.
exceptions.trigger: opposite-direction approaches with one intending or making a left turn

judgment_calls_needed.note: Entry-time relation requires a source-reviewed legal judgment; no numeric cutoff is supplied.

obligation.description: The left-side driver shall yield right-of-way to the vehicle on the right when the clause applies.

timing.description: Judge the relative entry times, not a later inside-intersection overtake.
